metadata.methods_description: EEG activity was recorded using dry electrode caps (DSI-Flex with 7 channels or DSI-24 with 24 channels) with hardware filtering (0.003-150 Hz bandwidth), sampled at 300 Hz with linked-ear reference and active common-mode follower. Data were downsampled to 150 Hz and filtered between 1-20 Hz (2nd-order) with 60 Hz notch filtering. Participants completed calibration tasks (55 inquiries per task) and copy-spelling tasks using Matrix or RSVP layouts presented at 5 Hz on a 24" monitor. Testing was conducted on an MSI Trident 3 desktop with Nvidia RTX 3060 GPU and 12th-gen Intel i7 processor.
